title: Which Egg Hides the Dragon?

Can YOU guess which egg is hiding the dragon? Watch to find out! 🐉🔥 Come back tomorrow for Level 2!

scenes.narration: One of these eggs is hiding a dragon — but which one?
You've got three choices — the red egg, the blue egg, or the golden egg!
Pick your egg right now — three, two, one!
The red egg — oh wow, it's just a tiny rubber duck! So close!
The blue egg — ooh, it's a wiggly worm! Not quite, buddy!
The golden egg — YES! A fire-breathing dragon hatching right now!
Did you get it right? Level two is coming tomorrow — don't miss it!
